title: Finite Q3 source-local graph-norm transfer and cutoff commutator stress
question: On an explicit low-occupation polynomial core, do the shifted source-local Q3 potential weights transfer through the full shifted Hamiltonian with finite graph and form constants, and does the associated commutator coefficient stay stable under volume, source translation and oscillator-cutoff stress?
method: Rebuild the canonical Q3 Hamiltonian on the target edge, square face and registered 2x3 seven-edge control graph for every manifest oscillator dimension.
For each declared source support, form the shifted onsite source potential weight and the shifted source-edge weight, retaining only bonds internal to the support.

Compute the form constant lambda_max(K_Lambda^(-1/2) K_S K_Lambda^(-1/2)), graph constant ||K_S K_Lambda^(-1)||, and right commutator constant ||[K_Lambda,K_S] K_Lambda^(-1)|| after shifting K_Lambda to spectral floor one.
Enumerate tensor Fock basis vectors with total occupation at most two and check the graph and commutator inequalities row by row against their finite operator constants.
Reconstruct all rows in a non-importing independent lane and cross-check the rational scenario, core-count and scope fixtures in Lean R356.
finding: The primary lane passes 1292/1292 assertions and the independent lane passes 1196/1196. The integrated verifier passes 206/206 with Lean R356 PASS. There are 38 source-weight scenarios and 544 explicit polynomial-core basis rows. Primary maxima are form=1.8039836560045446, graph=1.865789999507254 and commutator=4.015684693477961, with independent maxima agreeing within the 1e-7 lane tolerance. On the V=2 source-edge row, the commutator constant increases from 1.5449241615861335 at oscillator dimension 3 to 4.015684693477961 at dimension 8, giving the declared finite cutoff growth ratio 2.5992762579071593.
decision_reason: The calculation closes the finite bookkeeping needed to distinguish form domination from an operator graph estimate and exposes the exact source-edge commutator cost on an explicit core. The cutoff trend is a sampled route diagnostic, not an asymptotic divergence theorem; therefore it strengthens the calibration of the common-core gate without promoting a uniform estimate or a QFT construction.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite graph/form/commutator transfer stress. The finite core is not asserted dense, the cutoff is not removed, and no common dynamics, exhaustion independence, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, mass gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A or Clay conclusion follows.

adversarial_review.check: Form, graph and commutator constants are evaluated separately; no form-order implication is used as an operator theorem.
The source weight contains only onsite terms on the declared support and internal source bonds; crossing bonds are excluded.
Only the finite total-occupation-at-most-two Fock span is tested; domain density and cutoff removal remain open.
Both full and source weights are shifted to floor one before inverse and inverse-square-root factors are formed; no Gibbs inverse is used.
The independent lane rebuilds the matrix model and core rows without importing the primary implementation.
The 2.5992762579071593 ratio compares only the declared V=2 dimensions and is not a global no-go.
Common unbounded-core construction, exhaustion, common alpha, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, KMS/GNS, gap and continuum remain open.
R356 checks exact rational counts and scope only; matrix spectral calculus and thermodynamic limits remain Python/open analysis.

qft_interface.closed: Finite source-local Q3 potential and source-edge weights have explicit form, graph and commutator transfer constants on a low-occupation core across the declared volume, source and oscillator-cutoff grid.
qft_interface.open: A source-, volume- and cutoff-uniform analytic estimate, cutoff removal, a common unbounded core, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, all-shape exhaustion, common alpha, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, KMS/GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: Auxiliary C6/Q3 finite evidence only; no heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.

next_action: Use the finite constants as calibration only. Derive a source-, volume- and cutoff-uniform analytic commutator/graph estimate on a declared Q3 common core; if the cutoff coefficient cannot be bounded, retain the finite growth as route-local and switch to a cancellation-aware history topology before common-alpha promotion.
no_overclaim: This finite stress does not prove source/volume/cutoff uniformity, a thermodynamic dynamics, an OS/KMS/GNS construction, a mass gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A or a Clay result.
